name: athria-workout
purpose: Inspect and execute near-term workouts without redesigning the whole Mesocycle.
appliesWhen: The user asks what to do today, to add near-term sessions, skip, restore, or move a planned session, record or correct a manual workout, or explicitly correct a workout-plan match.
doesNotApplyWhen: The user asks to create or materially redesign the complete Current Mesocycle.
approvalPoints: Before every tool that changes a planned session, Training History, or plan match
safetyRules: Never rewrite the complete Current Mesocycle.
Never choose a plannedSessionId during normal recording or inferred matching.
Only override a match when the user explicitly identifies the workout and intended correction.
Preserve synced source observations when editing or removing a manual source.
